title: OPC UA Write
text: Write data to OPC UA server, 1 input; {Server} defines OPC UA server for block drop-down, {Nodes} sets the list of OPC UA server and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Server
params.values: Define OPC UA server for block drop-down list

params.name: Nodes
params.values: List of OPC UA server nodes table

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time for write operation -1 (default) | nonnegative scalar
